page.title: Sales pipeline
page.subtitle: Open deals by stage, a weighted forecast and discount approvals. Deals live in the CRM module (crm_deals).
page.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
page.truncated: Showing the {{count}} most recently updated deals. Older deals are not in the forecast.

pipeline.noStagesBody: Stages give each deal a win probability and a forecast category. Create the default set, then adjust it under Setup.
pipeline.noStagesNoPermission: Ask someone who can edit the business profile to create the stages.
pipeline.title: Deal / company
pipeline.noDeals: No open deals yet. Add one above, or connect a CRM under CRM Sync.

forecast.note: Weighted = amount × the stage win probability. Open deals in one currency only. Stage weights are proposed defaults: calibrate them against your own win rates.
forecast.excludedUnmapped: {{count}} deals with a stage that is not configured
forecast.excludedOtherCurrency: {{count}} deals in another currency or without one
forecast.noCurrency: No open deal has a currency yet, so no forecast can be shown.

desk.disabledBody: While it is off, discounts are not checked. The account owner turns it on under Setup.

metrics.note: Weekdays only (Mon–Fri, UTC), no holidays. Auto-approved requests are not counted as decisions.

request.title: Request a discount
request.reasonHelp: At least 10 characters. Say what the buyer compares us to and what we get in return.

setup.stagesHelp: Each stage carries a win probability and a forecast category. Match names are the stage names your CRM uses; comparison ignores case and extra spaces.
setup.label: Label
setup.noStages: No stages yet. Create the defaults from the Pipeline tab.
setup.noPermission: Only people who can edit the business profile can change stages.
setup.deskHelp: Discounts up to the automatic limit are approved at once. Up to the manager limit they need a manager other than the requester. Above that only the account owner can approve. Defaults are placeholders: set your own.
setup.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change this policy.

errors.order: The manager limit cannot be below the automatic limit.

api.discountRequiresApproval: This discount is above the automatic limit and needs an approved request first.

api.selfApproval: You cannot approve your own request.
api.ownerRequired: Only the account owner can decide this request.
